card.title: PANZER 35(t)
card.flavorText: The Panzerkampfwagen 35(t), commonly known as Panzer 35(t) was a Czechoslovakian light tank manufactured by Skoda, but mainly used by the German Wehrmacht during WWII. Only 434 units were built and of these the Germans seized 244 when they occupied Bohemia-Moravia in 1939. The Panzer 35 was used early in the war during the invasion of Poland, the Battle of France and the invasion of the Soviet Union, but retired from frontline services in 1942. The tank had a crew of 3 to 4 men, a main armament of 3.7 cm (1.5 in) KwK 34(t) gun and a secondary armament of 2 x 7.92 mm MG 37(t) machine guns.
